item.title: Marc Fornes' New Sculptural Pavilion Reimagines the Architectural Folly
item.description: Marc Fornes' new sculptural pavilion, "L'Ile Folie," is a contemporary landmark perched above a pond in Cary, North Carolina.

item.title: Breezy Swathes of Fabric Dance Amid Landscapes in Thomas Jackson's Photos
item.description: Multi-colored lengths of fabric billow in the breeze in the otherworldly photographic works of Thomas Jackson.

item.title: 'Let Us Gather In a Flourishing Way' Convenes 58 Artists to Survey Contemporary Latinx Painting
item.description: A survey of contemporary Latinx painting and a lively dialogue between a spectrum of artists with diverse identities, languages, and creative mediums.

item.title: Ben Zank’s Portraits Teeter Between Surrealism and the Mundane
item.description: Ben Zank has a knack for turning ordinary settings and unaccompanied figures into strangely perplexing sights.

item.title: Goran Konjevod Transforms Paper into Elegantly Organic Origami Vessels
item.description: In meticulously folded paper objects, Konjevod taps into the juxtapositions of material, form, and function.

item.title: Meditate to the Undulations of Baltic Sea Ice in Jan Erik Waider's Hypnotic Videos
item.description: Fresh ice formed a thin layer of faceted shapes on the rolling surface that moved gently without breaking apart.

item.title: How Do Artists Finance Their Lives? Join Us for a Discussion About Mason Currey's New Book
item.description: Mason Currey dives into the underexplored realm of art and money in his new book 'Making Art and Making a Living.'

item.title: Stephen Morrison's Trompe-L'œil 'Dog World' Paintings Are Fetching
item.description: Stephen Morrison's paintings "invite viewers to rediscover the magic and absurdity often obscured by the routine."

item.title: Austin Bell Chronicles Every Single One of Hong Kong's 2,549 Basketball Courts
item.description: Bell's series 'SHOOTING HOOPS' highlights the physical courts and conveys a unique portrait of the region.

item.title: A Doomed Mission to Mars Awaits Henry Wood's Lanky Explorers
item.description: For Henry Wood, the potential for inhabiting Mars has inspired a series of wooden figures with quite a turbulent backstory.
